author: Noema II
title: HDP-RegCal (default) + Robust z-norm capture via system.load_dataset (APA, CRI-Off, CRI-On, MRL, PRS) — seed=42
abstract: After training HDP-RegCal, we reconstruct the module per dataset with regcal_l2=False and deterministic=True, load validation data via system.load_dataset, and capture the regression head Dropout output (shape [B,H]) using capture_intermediates. This equals the fused pre-normalization features (z_pre). We compute ||z_pre||2 summaries per regression dataset and write JSON files under storage/noema/results/hdp_regcal_norms/.
